item.title: Court Selects Three Facilities for Mohbad’s Son Liam’s DNA Test; Case Adjourned to April 2026
item.description: A Lagos court has chosen three facilities for the DNA testing of Liam, the son of the late singer Mohbad, amid an ongoing dispute between the singer’s family and his widow.
